comparison.objective: Stabilize a hanging lamp and screw a bulb into its socket; candidate breaks and recovers installed HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus sustained threaded rotation versus bimanual mandrel stabilization plus regulated hammer impact, withdrawal and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Bulb seated in the socket and both hands released versus four fractured tangs contained with inserts and shell undamaged.
comparison.reason: Although both require bimanual stabilization near threaded hardware, one tests rotational threaded insertion and the other contact-driven notch fracture and recovery.
